backbone: CSPDarknet backbone (C2f) + PAN-FPN neck + Detect head — YOLOv8n architecture
library: ultralytics 8.4.77 (pip wheel; git commit not recorded)
preprocess: RGB -> LetterBox((640,640), auto=False, stride=32) -> divide_by_255 -> float32 -> CUDA; no mean/std, no augmentation, no TTA
candidate_export_point: pre-NMS dense anchor stream (8400 anchors x 8 Road8 classes = 67200 hypotheses); positive-area box filter (drop x2<=x1 or y2<=y1); no confidence threshold; no NMS; no objectness
threshold_nms_topn_order: sort by (score desc, anchor index asc, Road8 class id asc); keep top-100
score_semantics: post-sigmoid per-class score of the anchor's Road8 class; no objectness multiplication (YOLOv8 has no separate objectness branch)
source_id_definition: anchor index 0..8399 (row index in the concatenated 8400-anchor grid); 8 Road8 class candidates from one anchor share one source_id
native_layer: YOLOv8n Detect head final concatenated output tensor (84, 8400) = [4 box (xywh letterboxed px) | 80 post-sigmoid class scores]
record_to_native_association: one-to-8: each native row (anchor) <-> up to 8 Road8 class candidate records; join only by (image_id, source_id)
